messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No pointwise convergence implies uniform convergence. Counterexamples exist. Consider B_n(x) = x^n on [0,1]. Each term converges to 0 for x in [0,1). At x=1, limit is 1. Limit function f(x) is discontinuous at 1. Polynomials are continuous. Uniform limit of continuous functions must be continuous. Contradiction proves no uniform convergence.
